integrity: A self-contained all-parameter proof and a separate finite direct enumerator are supplied. The finite checker is not presented as an infinite proof. No independent scientific validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three one-markers over the binary alphabet; periodic factor-language semantics, not the truncated circular factor language. The finite checker validates bounded parameters only. Full text of one later reconstruction paper was inaccessible; absolute priority is not certified.
title: Three-marker circular binary antidictionaries: exact cardinality and extremizers
